MORE:
In continuation of our letter dated 7th November, 2026 intimating the notice of the Board Meeting, and pursuant to
Regulations 30 and 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing
Regulations'), we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today, i.e.
Friday, 13th November, 2026, has inter-alia considered and approved the following:
1. Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half-year
ended 30th September, 2026, along with the Statement of Assets and Liabilities and Cash Flow Statement
as at that date, as reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee at its meeting held earlier in the day.
We enclose the said Financial Results together with the Limited Review Reports issued by the Statutory
Auditors, M/s. R P S V & Co., Chartered Accountants, as Annexure - 2.
